5f2193a434209690de00df4b96e09bc7.overview: A man and a woman in Lagos want to escape their everyday lives, but extricating themselves is no easy task. Two stories narrated with tenderness and restraint that only fleetingly touch, the dream of migrating to Europe floating above them all the while.
5f2193a434209690de00df4b96e09bc7.tagline: You have a dream. Life has other plans.

5f6538ae302a08187da3d2f79bea51b0.overview: On a Tokyo dump’s shantytown edge, interwoven vignettes follow residents scraping by: a boy who “drives” an imaginary trolley, a homeless father and son designing a dream house, a young woman brutalized at home, drunks, schemers, and saints of small kindnesses. Kurosawa crafts a ragged mosaic of hardship, fantasy, and flickers of grace that keep people moving forward.

5fab4cc1a1d3a2c4a645dbcaa106489e.overview: A showcase of workers in the animal burial industry while dealing with heavier existential questions regarding mortality and the afterlife. Floyd 'Mac' McClure believes that a graceful burial is as important for pets as it is for people; he chronicles his struggles to keep his niche business afloat, and interviews several of his associates and one of his competitors, the manager of a rendering plant.
5fab4cc1a1d3a2c4a645dbcaa106489e.tagline: Death is for the living and not for the dead so much.

5fab5e948010e451a799fc51fbe72cca.overview: Residents of a rundown French apartment building battle against an army of deadly, rapidly reproducing spiders.

5fc278dabb0760d1b12acc15dc4c0e38.overview: After botching his latest assignment, a third-ranked Japanese hit man becomes the target of another assassin.

5fcaa1a0d4dbf8a5235c0ab9b37b9d1b.overview: Recently deceased, a white-sheeted ghost returns to his suburban home to console his bereft wife, only to find that in his spectral state he has become unstuck in time, forced to watch passively as the life he knew and the woman he loves slowly slip away.
